I've been disappointed by similar products before, so quality really matters to me.

I hear you, and that makes total sense. When you’ve been let down before, you really don’t want to risk it again.

A few things about Heirloom that might help you feel more confident:

All of our roses are premium own-root plants grown in our Oregon nurseries (we don’t buy from third-party growers), so you get the true variety and a long-lived plant.
Perennials and bulbs are also carefully sourced and inspected before shipping.
Roses are backed by a one-year guarantee, perennials by a 90-day guarantee, and bulbs by a failure-to-bloom guarantee.
Your plants arrive defoliated (without leaves) to travel safely, but they’re inspected to be healthy and ready to grow.

If you tell me a bit more about what you need, I can help you pick something very specific so you’re not guessing:

What type of plant are you considering right now?
Rose, hydrangea, something for pollinators, bulbs for fall, etc.

Sun in the spot: full sun (6+ hours), partial shade (about 4 hours), or mostly shade
